description: Adversarial multi-hop specification QA benchmark testing Tier 1 -> Tier 2 -> Tier 3 overrides, negative SKU prohibitions, and provenance trace verification.

items.question: We are quoting the complete assembly (piping, isolation valve, elastomer seal, flange bolting kit, and actuator) for Manifold Loop B at the Borealis facility operating at 120 PSI during winter conditions (-42°C). Which exact part SKUs are required?
items.expected_answer: For Manifold Loop B at -42°C and 120 PSI, the required SKUs are piping #PIPE-PEX9-ARC (or ASTM A333 Grade 6), Cryogenic Trunnion Valve #VLV-200-LT, Ultra-Low-Temp FFKM Seal #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90, low-temperature bolting kit #BOLT-L7-L4, and High-Torque Hydraulic Actuator #ACT-HYD-350.

items.question: What isolation valve body, elastomer seal, flange bolt kit, and actuator SKU are required for Manifold Loop A (Glycol Return, 110 PSI) at the Borealis facility during winter shutdown (-42°C)?
items.expected_answer: Manifold Loop A does not receive methanol injection (SEC-3.2), so it is subject to Cryogenic Excursion (SEC-4.3 / SEC-4.4) without the Polar-Solvent override. It requires standard valve body #VLV-200-SS fitted with Low-Temp Fluorosilicone seal #SEAL-FVMQ-40, low-temp bolt kit #BOLT-L7-L4, and baseline pneumatic actuator #ACT-PN-100.

items.question: Manifold Loop C (Produced Water) operates at 95 PSI in Zone-A3 (-42°C). Does Loop C require upgrading the piping to #PIPE-PEX9-ARC, and which bolting kit and seal SKU must be used?
items.expected_answer: Because Loop C operates at 95 PSI (which is not >100 PSI per SEC-4.1), the dynamic high-pressure polymer piping derating does not prohibit baseline #PIPE-HDPE11-STD, or if upgraded via SEC-4.3 general trigger, note that SEC-4.1 specifically targets dynamic pressurized service >100 PSI. However, Zone-A3 (-42°C) still triggers SEC-4.3 for bolting and seals, requiring bolt kit #BOLT-L7-L4 and Fluorosilicone seal #SEAL-FVMQ-40 inside valve #VLV-200-SS.

items.question: Why is pneumatic actuator #ACT-PN-100 prohibited on Manifold Loop B during winter operations, and what exact torque value and replacement SKU are mandated?
items.expected_answer: Manifold Loop B requires seal #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 inside valve #VLV-200-LT (per SEC-4.5). Under SEC-5.1, #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 increases stem breakaway torque by 185% at -40°C to 215 Nm. Because #ACT-PN-100 is only rated for 120 Nm, it will stall during emergency shutdown, so SEC-5.2 mandates High-Torque Hydraulic Actuator #ACT-HYD-350 (rated to 400 Nm).

items.category: Chemical Dosing Threshold (-20°C Sub-Zero vs Cryogenic Boundary)
items.question: If an enclosed test skid on Manifold Loop B operates at an ambient minimum temperature of -20°C (above the -30°C Cryogenic Excursion threshold, but below the -15°C methanol dosing threshold), which chemical injection skid activates and why does Fluorosilicone (#SEAL-FVMQ-40) fail?
items.expected_answer: Because ambient temperature (-20°C) is below -15°C, Automated Chemical Dosing Skid #DS-04 injects 8.0% anhydrous methanol into Manifold Loop B (SEC-3.2), classifying it as a Polar-Solvent Service Line (SEC-3.3). Per SEC-4.5, Fluorosilicone (#SEAL-FVMQ-40) experiences severe volumetric swell (>45%) and extrusion failure in anhydrous methanol + trace hydrocarbon mixtures.

items.category: Temperate Baseline Control Case (No Overrides Triggered)
items.question: We are quoting an indoor temperate test loop (+20°C minimum ambient, 120 PSI, zero methanol dosing) using the Borealis baseline schedule. Which pipe, valve, seal, bolt kit, and actuator SKUs are approved?
items.expected_answer: At +20°C with no methanol dosing, Tier 1 Baseline schedules (Section 2.0) govern without excursion overrides: pipe #PIPE-HDPE11-STD, valve #VLV-200-SS, Viton seal #SEAL-VT-09, bolt kit #BOLT-B7-2H, and pneumatic actuator #ACT-PN-100.

items.question: According to the specification's Order of Precedence, if a Tier 2 Environmental Override conflicts with a Tier 3 Active Safety Interlock, which section wins and what clause defines this rule?
items.expected_answer: Per Volume I, Section 1.3 (Order of Precedence for Conflicting Specifications), Tier 3 Active Safety Interlocks (Volume II, Section 5.0) strictly SUPERSEDE both Tier 1 (Section 2.0 Baseline) and Tier 2 (Section 4.0 Environmental & Chemical Overrides).

items.question: At what exact temperature do baseline ASTM A193 Grade B7 stud bolts (#BOLT-B7-2H) exhibit Charpy V-notch impact degradation, and what exact bolt/nut kit replaces them under Section 4.2?
items.expected_answer: Per Section 4.2, ASTM A193 Grade B7 stud bolts (#BOLT-B7-2H) exhibit rapid Charpy V-notch impact degradation below -29°C and must be replaced with Charpy impact-tested ASTM A320 Grade L7 stud bolts paired with ASTM A194 Grade 4/L4 nuts (Kit #BOLT-L7-L4).
